outreach_draft.subject: A thought on your Personal Injury page
outreach_draft.body:
Hi Mitchell,

I was looking through your current site and noticed that Criminal Defense and Personal Injury are both presented on the same one-page experience. Those are very different clients with different questions, urgency, and proof points, so someone arriving after an injury is sharing the same general website conversation as someone facing a criminal charge.

A focused Personal Injury page could give injury clients a clearer path to the cases you handle, what working with you looks like, and the next step to take. It would also give Google a more focused service context and make the site easier for AI systems to interpret when people ask specifically about injury representation.

Personal Injury seems like the best first mockup because it is already explicitly offered but has no dedicated destination today.

I’m putting together a quick mockup to show you what I mean. I’ll send it over in the next couple of days.

If you’d rather I didn’t, just let me know.
